text: Entry 1168 adds gBrowser.getTabForBrowser returning null to the browser-request window. Accepted extensionPopup and viewSource use the same null contract, while tabmail searches its real tabs and also returns null on a miss. Scoped compatibility pattern: implement the method expected by shared browser code without fabricating a tab for these standalone windows. The triggering Gecko caller and its paired revision were not established here. This is source and test inspection only. Full Bugzilla and historical review discussion remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran.
title: Use a null tab result for browser windows that have no tab object
